_reviewGateNote: The review gate is GIT-NATIVE, not a Claude Code hook — a git hook runs OUTSIDE the agent and is invoked by git on the ACTUAL commit/push (any spelling: compound, subshell, alias, eval, even a human's terminal push), so it cannot be walked around by the shell-obfuscation bypasses a command-string parser suffers. Install: `git config core.hooksPath hooks/git` (metareview `/setup` wires this). Two hooks: `hooks/git/pre-push` is the HARD gate — it runs `metareview review gate --push` (deterministic; no model) and BLOCKS an unreviewed/unresolved branch (nonzero exit aborts the push before it reaches the remote), failing CLOSED; `git push --no-verify` is the git-native escape hatch. `hooks/git/post-commit` NEVER blocks (a commit saves work) — it names the files the commit wrote and prints a review-OWED nudge to stderr, which the agent sees in the `git commit` output. Both only run DETERMINISTIC metareview and emit exit codes + messages; the AGENT reads those, builds the subagent review prompts, runs the reviews, and calls metareview to record coverage (metareview adjudicates) before re-pushing. Keep ./bin/metareview built (`go build -o bin/metareview ./cmd/metareview`) or set METAREVIEW_BIN, or the pre-push gate fails closed.
